original: Hi, and thanks for choosing AcmeBrands! How can I help you today?
Hi, I want to find out about gift wrapping my items. Like the cost etc
I'd be happy to assist you with that.
Let me check that information for you.
Gift wrapping is $4.99 per item. However, it may not be available for oversized items.
You can add up to 300 characters as a message on your purchase, but must specify a separate message for each item to be gift wrapped, even if it is a repeat.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
It is $4.99 per item purchased, when available.
I have 3 items but they're going to the same address so what would the total be?
The total for gift wrapping would be $14.97.
what if they all were wrapped in the same box?
We only wrap individual items separately.
are you sure? my friend got hers wrapped in the same box and she said it was  cheaper
I'm afraid we only wrap separately.
can you double check? they did it for her.
I have double checked, and my information shows that it is fixed at $4.99 per item.
I will escalate this to my manager.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
how will I find out the answer?
you didn't even ask my name!
I will pull up your account so that it is on record. What is your full name?
Account has been pulled up for Albert Sanders.
Your account has been pulled up. Can I help you with anything else today?
what phone number do you have for me?
I am unable to see that information, but my manager will have access to your full account.
Guest simply means that you do not have a paid membership, but you still have an account in our system.
(634) 811-2214 please add this number to my account. what you are telling me does not make sense.
thank you! I don't have high hopes of getting a call though.
You will, I assure you. Have a nice day!
